<function name="ResetModelLighting" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Resets the model lighting to the specified color.

It has the same effect as calling <page>render.SetModelLighting</page> for every direction with given color.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="r" type="number">The red part of the color, 0-1.</arg>
		<arg name="g" type="number">The green part of the color, 0-1.</arg>
		<arg name="b" type="number">The blue part of the color, 0-1.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
